about: Every point where the mod touches Fallout: New Vegas. One row = one hook. A null cell is unfilled; verified=false means the call has not been checked in the running game.

columns.id: unique hook id, referenced by other sheets
columns.call: the script call (vanilla GECK script or xNVSE) that implements it
columns.provider: vanilla | xnvse | other (anything other than vanilla/xnvse must be bundled)
columns.verified: true once tested in the running game

rows.notes: Opens the buy menu anywhere; edge-detected in the quest script so one press = one open
HUD armor, bottom-left. New Vegas armor is DT, shown as the CS-style armor number
HUD ammo, bottom-right: rounds in clip / total reserve. Reserve = player.GetItemCount <ammo>; in-clip count needs a call confirmed in xNVSE docs
Money shown as caps on the HUD and buy menu
Silent remove when a purchase succeeds
Weapon and its starter ammo land in inventory
Draw the CS-style HUD. Route still open: injected UI XML on the HUD menu vs. a tile-based menu; must work with xNVSE alone or a bundled, shareable plugin

rows.call: ShowMessage CSNVBuyMenuMsg (message form with one button per buy_menu row)
rows.notes: v1 fallback that needs nothing extra; CS2 styling of it is an open item
